page.layout: One printed page. Full-width title block at top (work title in capitals, then PRAEFATIO. with a large woodcut ornament above it). Below: one column of running text with a large initial E. One marginal reference in the right margin beside the first lines. Page number at top right. Signature mark centred at the foot.

main_text.head: IOHANNIS RAINOLDI, IN LIBROS DE ROMANÆ ECCLESIÆ idololatria,
PRAEFATIO.
main_text.p: ECCLESIASTES, quum omnia humana rerum fluxarum fugaciúmque studia, vanissima esse demonstrasset, ac documenta tradidisset verae pietatis & reverentiæ Dei: {a}Ex istis, inquit, fili mi, admonitus esto: faciendi libros multos nullus est finis, & lectio multorum fatigationi est carni: summa rei est, his omnibus auditis; Deum reverere, & præcepta eius observa, quia hoc est totum hominis. Sapienter quidem ille nos adhortans, ut studia salutaria, perceptu faciliora; fructu perennia, iis anteponamus, quorum infinita est investigatio, nec alius demum exitus, quàm labor & aerumna. Quanquam fit quorundam partim ignorantia, partim contumacia, ut in praestantissimo quoque pietatis & cultus Dei studio, idem aliquatenus usuvenire videatur, quod in ceteris notat Salomon. Nam, de conservanda fide sarta tecta, de repurganda doctrina, de disciplina instauranda; de eliminandis erroribus, haeresibus, idololatriis; denique de cunctisEccl. 12.14[?]

page.notes: The large initial E is joined to the small-capitals word "CCLESIASTES", read as ECCLESIASTES. The reference "Eccl. 12.14" in the right margin is partly faint; the numerals may read 12.14 rather than 1244, so it is marked [?]. The first word of the text is set in a woodcut initial. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the background and was left out. Faint show-through at the lower left was also left out.
